## Whitespace contradicts operator precedence Whitespace around nested operators contradicts precedence. --- The best fix is to make operator grouping explicit and consistent by adding parentheses around each logical operand and normalizing whitespace around operators. This preserves functionality while removing ambiguity for readers and satisfying the static analysis rule.

In packages/runner/src/release-pipeline.ts, update the object spread condition on line 195:

  • From: 'publicBody' in record&&record.publicBody!==undefined
  • To: ('publicBody' in record) && (record.publicBody !== undefined)

No imports, new methods, or new definitions are required.

## Superfluous trailing arguments Superfluous argument passed to function assertProductDelivery. ---

To fix this without changing existing functionality, remove the extra trailing argument from the assertProductDelivery call in scripts/release-coordinator.mjs.

  • **General fix approach:** when a function is called with more arguments than it accepts, remove the unnecessary trailing argument unless you are also updating the function definition and all call sites.
  • **Best fix here:** update line 176 region so assertProductDelivery is called with only delivery.
  • **File/region to edit:** scripts/release-coordinator.mjs, inside releaseParticipation, in the try block where delivery is parsed and validated.
  • **No imports/dependencies needed.** No method or definition additions are required.

## Whitespace contradicts operator precedence Whitespace around nested operators contradicts precedence. --- To fix this, update the conditional on scripts/select-pages-source.mjs line 78 so operator boundaries are visually explicit and align with precedence.
Best single fix without changing functionality: keep the logic identical, but add spaces around && and === in the catch guard expression.

Change region:

  • scripts/select-pages-source.mjs, in cycleForRelease, the catch(error) line.

No imports, methods, or new definitions are needed.

result.impactZh: 原文说明这会造成阅读歧义（ambiguity for readers），并触发静态分析规则关注；原文未说明具体运行时故障。
